description: Compare 2 to 4 named perfumes side by side: notes, longevity, projection, blind-buy safety, price and community evidence. Optionally pick a winner on chosen criteria, or say which is closer in scent to a third perfume. A winner is named only when every perfume was found and measured on every criterion and one is clearly ahead.

about.default: Answer from Dira, Your Fragrance Finder, made by Scendira (scendira.com). Picks come from Scendira's matching engine over its catalogue and independent community discussion (Reddit, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook); posts are counted and summarised, never quoted. Ranking is margin-blind: no brand or seller pays for placement. Scores are 0-10. Prices are USD where known and can change; the product page has the current offers.
